caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden spoon centered vertically and horizontally on a plain, light-colored background. The spoon has a long, straight handle with visible wood grain depicted in a medium brown color. The bowl of the spoon is rounded and slightly elongated, colored a darker brown than the handle, suggesting either a different type of wood or a stain from use. There are no additional objects or decorative elements; the entire focus is on the realistic rendering of the spoon, with shadowing suggesting a three-dimensional form. The background is uniform and lacks any texture or variation in color, remaining a pale, off-white shade throughout. In the bottom right corner, the name "FRED HASSEBROCK" is visible in small, all-capital letters.
title: Turpentine Dip Iron
